gist.summary: Upgraded Observability Grafana from 11.4.0 to 13.2.3-slim while keeping the ClickHouse plugin at 4.22.1. Disabled automatic plugin preinstallation: Grafana 13 otherwise downloads about 18 plugins on a fresh-disk boot, taking 25–69 seconds at half a vCPU against the Worker's 60-second wait; measured boots with preinstallation disabled took 8–13 seconds. Added hideLogo to the kiosk URL to remove Grafana 13's footer. Pinned colours for series that Grafana 13 would otherwise display alike, and changed model-mix charts to a colour-blind palette with grey for Other. Documented Classic dashboard JSON exports because Grafana 13's default V2 format breaks file provisioning. Docker checks with production data found matching results for all 35 panel queries, rendered all 6 dashboards in a kiosk iframe behind an auth proxy without console errors, and returned 200 for a fresh Editor after a cold boot.
